name: Supine Hamstring Stretch with Band

instructions.description: Lie on the back and loop a band around one foot.
Raise the leg while holding the band with both hands.
Keep the pelvis relaxed and stop at a mild stretch.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record range only when measured consistently; do not force end range.

variations.variationDescription: Supine Hamstring Stretch with Band — Supported Mobility Version: Add stable support or cushions to reduce balance or floor-access demands.

commentsNotes: Keep the knee slightly bent if needed.
